title: MASteer: Multi-Agent Adaptive Steer Strategy for End-to-End LLM Trustworthiness Repair

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model fairness and stereotype reliance using multiple-choice questions from the BBQ (Bias Benchmark for Question Answering) dataset.
Evaluating model behavior using AI-generated AB-test-style contrastive samples focused on gender representation in professional roles and gendered assumptions about STEM capabilities.
Using multi-agent generated question-answer pairs to assess the model's handling of the combined intersectional effects of race and gender discrimination.
Assessing equitable access patterns by evaluating generated contrastive samples regarding access to educational resources across different income levels.
Evaluating generated diagnostic samples that test for the reflection of historical biases, such as colonial perspectives in historical event interpretations.
